The 2026 Openfront Masters Spring Minor is the first OFM seasonal event of the year, being organized as a qualifier for the 2026 Openfront Spring Major.

About

Format

  • Group Stage - February 21th & 22nd, 2026
    • 6 trio matches played using a match-point system in 2 groups
    • Teams earn points based on their maximum land size reached during each match
  • Point Distribution (per match)
      • 1st: 25 points
      • 2nd: 20 points
      • 3rd: 16 points
      • 4th: 12 points
      • 5th: 9 points
      • 6th: 6 points
      • 7th: 4 points
      • 8th: 2 points
      • 9th: 1 point
      • 10th: 0 points
    • Top five teams of each group advance to the 2026 Openfront Spring Major
  • Scoring Method
    • At the end of each match, referees record the largest territory size each team reached at any moment during the game
    • Teams are ranked using this maximum land value, and points are awarded accordingly
  • Tie-Breaker Rule
    • After all 6 matches, if multiple teams are tied above the Top 4, a 3v3 tie-breaker match will be played between the tied teams
    • The winner determines final placement and qualification

Prize Pool

Exclusive Pattern Collection – awarded to the top 3 teams of each group.
